description: Random impulse generator: it fires impulses at a rate you set, each one as tall as a number drawn from a distribution you choose

params.text: Sets how often an impulse fires, one a second at the bottom of its travel and 20000 a second at the top
Chooses the shape the impulse heights are drawn from, out of UNI, CAUCHY, LOGIST, HYPERBCOS, ARCSINE, EXP and DUST; each position picks the shape named one position below it
Sets the shape parameter of the chosen distribution, 0.0001 to 1

inputs.text: Raises the impulse rate, 5V covering the whole of the density knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Steps the distribution choice, about 0.83V moving it on by one position, added to whatever the switch is set to
Shifts the shape parameter, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it

outputs.text: The impulses, up to 8V tall, through a DC blocker

notes: the module runs on its own and needs no clock: at the default density it fires around a hundred and forty impulses a second, and it is silent only when the density is turned all the way down.
